editorial.blurb: A buzzy Chinese cocktail bar where generous portions, expertly crafted drinks, and standout dishes like dry-fried green beans and hand-rolled noodles create the kind of night that keeps people lining up before opening.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive right at 5 pm opening or call ahead—the line fills fast—and order cocktails at the bar while you wait for a table; ask your server about vegan customizations, which the kitchen handles expertly even though they aren't formally labeled on the menu.
